name: command-menu
title: Command Menu
description: A keyboard-driven command palette: the backdrop dims, a query types itself, the list filters, and the first row is picked.
useWhen: Demoing a command-K palette opening with a typed query filtering icon-labelled commands.
Showing keyboard-first navigation in a developer or power-user product video.
Demonstrating row hover and press states with trailing keyboard shortcuts.
avoidWhen: The list has no icons or shortcuts and is opened from a button: use dropdown-menu.
The overlay is a right-click menu: use context-menu.
You only need a filterable input without a modal overlay: use combobox.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Items
variables.description: JSON array of {"icon","label","shortcut"}. Icons: user, settings, file, search.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
